flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui src/App.tsx, src/i18n/en/translation.json, src/utils/validation/Format/ValidFile.ts, src/utils/models/Icourtcase.d.ts, src/pages/NoticeSearch/{form/NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx,hook/useSearch.ts,hook/useSearchParams.tsx,list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx}, src/pages/Notice/{context/NoticeContext.tsx,form/History.tsx}, src/pages/Report/{index.tsx,action/ActionReport.tsx}, src/utils/config/env.ts. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase/OcmsCourtCase.java (3 columns) and workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController (inbound CAS, not credited). ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no court document upload code
note: The court document upload epic has no code in the six repos. Only leftovers exist in ocmsadminui: the label 'Court Upload Documents' in translation.json:105-106, the file rule court_upload_doc (10 MB, Document) in ValidFile.ts:182-185 which no component uses, the Icourtcase type (doc_type, file_name, b_lob, send_to_sc_flag) in Icourtcase.d.ts:41-49 with no upload user in the UI, and an empty '{/* COURT */}' block in App.tsx:313. The OcmsCourtCase entity in ocmsadminapi has only 3 columns (notice_no, court_payment_due_date, reason; OcmsCourtCase.java:20-31) and is used by the inbound CAS endpoints (CasIntegrationController), not for document upload; the CAS endpoints are not credited because no step of this story matches them. State Courts SFTP/batch is not in the six repos (earlier court epic finding). The status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)' is a sheet claim; the code does not support it. This story only asks for the Court Upload Document menu, the court case type choice, and the search prompt. None of the three exists in code. The story status 'Demo paid' with remark 'Court > Court Upload Document' is not found in the staff portal: the COURT block in App.tsx:313 is empty.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no menu, route, or court case type choice for document upload.

steps.step: Officer opens the Court > Court Upload Document menu
steps.detail: The '{/* COURT */}' block in App.tsx:313 is empty: there is no route for a court document upload page. The label 'Court Upload Documents' is only text in translation.json:105-106 and no component calls it (grep court_upload, CourtUpload, upload_documents in the six repos: no user other than translation.json and ValidFile.ts). There is no court upload controller in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi.

steps.step: Officer selects the court case type (court case, mention, trial, warrant request, generic file attachment, statement fact)
steps.detail: There is no dropdown or list of court case types for upload. Only the file rule court_upload_doc (maxsize 10, format Document) exists in ValidFile.ts:182-185, and grep court_upload_doc finds only its definition. The words 'mention slip', 'statement of fact', 'generic file', 'warrant request' do not appear in UI or API code; the mention, trial and warrant of arrest labels in translation.json:103-126 are used only for notice search.

steps.step: After the type is chosen, OCMS prompts the officer to search by notice or summons number
steps.detail: Because there is no type selection, no prompt follows it. The general Notice Search form does have notice_no (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:64) and summon_no (:438) fields, but it stands alone and is not routed from a court upload flow. The search function itself is judged in OCMS29.2.
